evals.prompt: 同步 BlueCortexCE 到上游最新版本
evals.expected_output: Skill should recognize claude-mem-java as an experimental reference, use the default backend and WebUI URLs without asking for them, and ask only for the local claude-mem-java checkout path when it is not already provided. It must not treat the source as production-ready or proceed without a valid path, regardless of the Agent Skills-compatible host runtime.

evals.prompt: 我们的后端需要合并 claude-mem 的新功能
evals.expected_output: Skill should use https://github.com/wubuku/claude-mem-fork.git and https://github.com/Blueforce-Tech-Inc/claude-mem.git by default, inspect WebUI alignment from Git, explain the experimental-source positioning, and describe the ideas to be evaluated.

evals.prompt: 更新 WebUI 子模块并同步上游改进
evals.expected_output: Skill gathers or reuses the local checkout path, creates or updates docs/drafts/upstream-sync-plan.md without private paths, treats the work as controlled adaptation, checks API compatibility, and does not update or commit the WebUI submodule silently.

evals.prompt: 追踪 claude-mem 的最新改进
evals.expected_output: Skill asks for the local path only when missing, analyzes recent commits from origin/main against a verified baseline, identifies feature gaps and risks, and creates an adaptation plan rather than assuming a production merge.

evals.prompt: 我想把上游的 platform_source 功能加到我们的项目里
evals.expected_output: Skill checks whether platform_source and V18 already exist in BlueCortexCE, avoids duplicate migrations, and proposes independent review and tests before adapting any remaining idea.

evals.prompt: 请在 Codex 或 OpenClaw 中使用 upstream-sync，研究 claude-mem-java 的一个改进
evals.expected_output: Skill should work from the project-local .agents/skills/upstream-sync location without assuming Claude Code hooks, Codex-only commands, OpenClaw-only APIs, or a particular agent lifecycle. It should preserve the experimental-source warning, private-path redaction, WebUI/API compatibility checks, and controlled-adaptation workflow.
